segments.he: אֲפִלּוּ אִם אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְהָרִים קוֹלוֹ כְּלָל אַל יִתְיָאֵשׁ
segments.en: This is the aspect of Hoshana Rabbah — when the sealing of the decree is completed, and the rectification begun on Rosh HaShanah is completed. On Rosh HaShanah Hashem had mercy on us and judged us favorably according to our place — for He knows the inclination of each one according to his place, since He is, as it were, the Place of the world. And through this He truly brought us into the scale of merit and planted in us the path of teshuvah — to cry out to Hashem from the depths of the heart, in the aspect of "from the depths I called to You, Hashem," which begins on Rosh HaShanah. And now on Hoshana Rabbah, at the end of Sukkos, all of Yisrael merits this aspect — to fulfill "do not judge your fellow until you have reached his place" [Avos 2:4], but to judge everyone favorably, and to fulfill "do not despise any person, whoever he may be" [Avos 4:3]. For during Sukkos we all merited to sit in the sukkah which is the aspect of the Throne of Glory — the Place of the world. And through this there was illuminated upon each and every person in Yisrael an illumination from the aspect of the Place of the world, to know to judge everyone favorably — even the sinners of Yisrael, the worst of the worst — until we merit to bring everyone into the scale of merit and to illuminate in them the illumination of Rosh HaShanah: that they always find an opening and a path to teshuvah, in every place they are, at every time and moment. And the essential opening and path is to cry out always from the depths of the heart to Hashem, whatever the situation — and never to despair of crying out, as Rabbainu of blessed memory warned about this countless times in many and various formulations.

segments.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת סוֹד קְרִיעַת יַם סוּף כִּי מְבאָר בִּפְרִי עֵץ חַיִּים שֶׁהוּא סוֹד מחִין דְּקַטְנוּת מְאד וְכוּ' שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהַמְתִּיקָם אֶלָּא עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת עַתִּיקָא שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מַה תִּצְעַק אֵלָי בְּעַתִּיקָא תַּלְיָא מִלְּתָא וְכוּ'. עַיֵּן שָׁם הֵיטֵב בְּכַוָּנוֹת שְׁבִיעִי שֶׁל פֶּסַח שֶׁמַּפְלִיג שָׁם מְאד מְאד בְּעצֶם עַמְקוּת הַסּוֹד הַזֶּה וְכוּ' עַיֵּן שָׁם.
segments.en: And this is the aspect of what we multiply on Hoshana Rabbah — crying out many times Hoshana, Hoshana [please save us]. And we stay awake the whole night and complete the entire Book of Tehillim which is filled with cries and outcries and pleas and supplications and entreaties and prayers to Hashem in many and various holy formulations, spoken in the holy spirit, encompassing all who come into the world — until there is no sinner and transgressor in the world who cannot find himself in the Book of Tehillim, which encompasses all who come into the world in all generations and all levels, from the highest to the lowest — to the very end of descent, beyond which there is no further descent, Heaven forbid. To all of them it arouses through its cries and prayers to return to Hashem.

segments.he: וְעַל פִּי דְּבָרִים הַנַּ"ל (בְּאוֹת מ' מ"א וְכוּ') יְכוֹלִים לְהָבִין מִזֶּה רְמָזִים נִפְלָאִים לְהִתְחַזֵּק בִּתְפִלָּה בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁהוּא אֲפִלּוּ בְּקַטְנוּת דְּקַטְנוּת שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְבָאֵר כְּלָל אֲפִלּוּ אִם נָפַל לִבְחִינַת קַטְנוּת מְאד הַמְרֻמָּז בְּעִנְיַן הַסַּכָּנָה שֶׁהָיָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּשֶׁעָמְדוּ עַל הַיָּם עַל פִּי כַּוָּנוֹת הָאֲרִ"י הַנַּ"ל בְּעִנְיַן הַהוּא נָחָשׁ וְכוּ'.
segments.en: And on Hoshana Rabbah — which is the aspect of Dovid, at the very end of the days of Sukkos — we draw down this wondrous rectification, that every person in Yisrael will merit, through the holiness of Rosh HaShanah and Yom Kippur and through having fulfilled the commandment of the sukkah and the Four Species — all of which are in the aspect of the Throne of Glory, the Place of the world — through all this we merit to judge everyone favorably and to plant in every person in Yisrael the paths of teshuvah: to recite Tehillim and to cry out to Hashem always, whatever the situation. And this is the aspect of Mishneh Torah [the Book of Devarim] which is read on the night of Hoshana Rabbah — for the entire Book of Devarim consists of Moshe's words of rebuke to Yisrael, a rebuke of kindness, to show them Hashem's kindnesses and His goodness and His righteousness forever. And Moses warned us in his holy teaching that whatever they do in every generation, Hashem's love and compassion for them never cease — as it is written: "And now, Yisrael, what does Hashem your G-d ask of you..." [Devarim 10:12], and Rashi explains: "Even though you did all this, His compassion and His love for you remain after all your sins — He asks of you only to fear Him..." And there is no fear except prayer, as the verse states: "A woman who fears Hashem shall be praised" [Mishlei 31:30]. As Rabbainu of blessed memory taught many times — meaning that Moshe warns and admonishes Yisrael for all generations that after all their sinning before Him, Heaven forbid, the Holy One blessed be He asks of them only fear, which is prayer — to pray and cry out to Him always. And never, whatever may come upon any one of them until the coming of Moshiach — never to despair of mercy, as our Rabbis of blessed memory said: Even if a sharp sword rests on a person's neck, he should not refrain from seeking mercy. And they said: Crying out is good for a person, both before a decree and after a decree. Therefore the whole Book of Devarim revolves around this axis — to remind Yisrael of all that they have angered before Him, yet even so never to despair of mercy. For His compassion is never exhausted, as they saw with their own eyes — that even after they made the Golden Calf, He still did not withhold His compassion from them. And so after all the other sins He dealt with them in His kindness, until they are now ready to enter the Land of Yisrael. Therefore they should know for all generations that whatever passes over them until the coming of Moshiach, and whatever passes over each individual — never despair of mercy, as Rabbainu of blessed memory taught: even if one is in the lowest depths, one can still be close to Him. And therefore Moshe warned them at the opening of the song: "For I will call the name of Hashem; ascribe greatness to our G-d" [Devarim 32:3] — saying to Yisrael: "From me you shall see and thus you shall do" — for know that all I merited in this world came entirely from calling always to Hashem, in the aspect of for I will call the name of Hashem. So too: hurry, do as I do — ascribe greatness to our G-d, that you too call always to Hashem as I do. For this is the very essence of His greatness and honor, as it is written: "Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you and you shall honor Me." Therefore on Hoshana Rabbah we read the Book of Mishneh Torah — for this is the very essence of Hoshana Rabbah: to draw down this path upon each and every person, to cry out always to Hashem.

segments.he: אַף עַל פִּי כֵן אֵין יֵאוּשׁ בָּעוֹלָם וְיֵשׁ וְיֵשׁ תִּקְוָה עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת עַתִּיקָא וְכוּ'. שֶׁמִּשָּׁם סוֹד מִנְחַת הָעמֶר שְׂעוֹרִים שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת עֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה שֶׁלּא נִתְגַּלָּה לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ וְכוּ' וְכַמְבאָר לְעֵיל שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שֶׁצְּרִיכִין לְהִתְחַזֵּק (שֶׁקּוֹרִין דֶּער הַאלְטְין זִיךְ) גַּם שָׁם עַל יְדֵי חֵלֶק מֵאֶלֶף אֲלָפִים וְרִבֵּי רְבָבוֹת שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ בִּבְחִינַת מִנְחָה שֶׁהוּא קָרְבַּן עָנִי שֶׁיְּכוֹלִין לַהֲבִיאוֹ לַחֲצָאִין וְכֵן לְכַמָּה חֲלָקִים כְּמוֹ מִנְחַת הָעמֶר שְׂעוֹרִים שֶׁבָּא קמֶץ מִנְחָה שֶׁל שְׂעוֹרִים מִכָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל. וְעַל יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה שֶׁהִיא אֲפִלּוּ בִּבְחִינָה זוֹ.
segments.en: This is the aspect of the shofar blasts, which are threefold in every aspect, as the Mishnah states: "The order of blasts — three sets of three." For the shofar blasts are the aspect of the rectification of voices that arouse from the depths — the aspect of "from the straits I called to G-d" [Tehillim 118:5] — meaning that through the shofar blasts, the illumination of teshuvah is drawn upon Yisrael: to always cry out to Hashem from the very depths of their hearts, from wherever they are. This is the primary rectification. And therefore we blow many voices many times, three by three. For so it must be — one must multiply cries and pleas to Hashem all the days of one's life and never grow weary. As Rabbainu of blessed memory warned us never to despair of crying out. For the rectification of every matter cannot happen all at once — and certainly one who has caused damage as he has caused damage must tarry greatly in his rectification, in the aspect of: one who comes to purify himself is assisted — but is told to wait. As is written in the kabbalistic writings regarding the rectification of Adam's sin: because of its great magnitude it cannot be rectified in one day, only from Rosh HaShanah until Shemini Atzeres — and even in all that time it is not fully rectified, but only bit by bit each year, until the time of "He will swallow up death forever."

segments.he: גַּם עַל יְדֵי זֶה יְכוֹלִין לְהִוָּשֵׁעַ. כִּי דַּיְקָא תְּפִלָּה הַזּאת יְקָרָה מְאד אֵצֶל ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ כַּנַּ"ל. כִּי הִיא בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה לֶעָנִי וְכוּ'. בְּחִינַת עֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה שֶׁלּא נִתְגַּלָּה לְאַבְרָהָם, כִּי זֶה הַסּוֹד אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְגַלּוֹת עַד הֵיכָן רַחֲמָיו מַגִּיעִים בְּחִינַת וְאֶל אֱלקֵינוּ כִּי יַרְבֶּה לִסְלחַ וְכוּ' כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַבְנוּ לְעֵיל שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מַה תִּצְעַק אֵלָי וְכוּ' בְּעַתִּיקָא תַּלְיָא וְכוּ'. כִּי זֶה הַסּוֹד הוּא בִּבְחִינַת עַתִּיקָא בְּחִינַת רַעֲוָא דְּרַעֲוִין שֶׁשָּׁם נִסְתַּלֵּק יוֹסֵף משֶׁה דָּוִד וְכוּ' כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַבְנוּ שָׁם (בְּאוֹת מ"ו) וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּהַתּוֹרָה הַנַּ"ל אִתְּתָךְ גּוּצָא גְּחִין וּלְחִישׁ לָהּ שֶׁהִוא בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה הַיְנוּ כְּשֶׁהַמַּלְכוּת בְּקַטְנוּת בִּבְחִינַת אִתְּתָךְ גּוּצָא בְּחִינַת הַמָּאוֹר הַקָּטָן וְכוּ' צָרִיךְ לְהָקִים אוֹתָהּ וְכוּ'. הַיְנוּ עַל פִּי הַנַּ"ל שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ שֶׁתְּפִלָּתוֹ בְּתַכְלִית הַקַּטְנוּת וְהַשִּׁפְלוּת אַף עַל פִּי כֵן כְּשֶׁמִּתְחַזֵּק בִּתְפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים מִשָּׁם. הוּא מְקַיֵּם אֶת בְּחִינַת הַמָּאוֹר הַקָּטָן וְכוּ'. שֶׁיְּקֻיַּם אֶת שְׁנֵי הַמְּאוֹרוֹת הַגְּדוֹלִים וְכוּ' וְעַיֵּן מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב שָׁם. וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת וּלְחִישׁ בְּחִינַת הַתְּפִלָּה שֶׁהִיא בְּלַחַשׁ. הַיְנוּ שֶׁלִּפְעָמִים הָאָדָם בְּקַטְנוּת כָּזֶה עַד שֶׁאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְהָרִים קוֹלוֹ כְּלָל. אַף עַל פִּי כֵן אַל יִתְיָאֵשׁ עַצְמוֹ מִן הַתְּפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים. וִיקַיֵּם וְשָׁפַלְתְּ מֵאֶרֶץ תְּדַבֵּרִי וּמֵעָפָר אִמְרָתֵךְ תְּצַפְצֵף. שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מִמַּעֲמַקִּים קְרָאתִיךָ הַשֵּׁם מֵעִמְקֵי עִמְקֵי פְּנִימִיּוּת הַלֵּב וְכוּ' בְּחִינַת צָעַק לִבָּם אֶל הַשֵּׁם שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה בְּלַחַשׁ שֶׁתִּקְּנוּ חֲכָמֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל בְּלַחַשׁ בִּשְׁבִיל קְטַנִּים שֶׁבַּקְּטַנִּים גְּרוּעִים שֶׁבַּגְּרוּעִים וּבִשְׁבִיל גְּדוֹלִים שֶׁבַּגְּדוֹלִים. כִּי הַקְּטַנִּים מְאד כָּל תְּפִלָּתָם הִיא בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה בְּלַחַשׁ כַּנַּ"ל. וְכָל תִּקּוּנָם עַל יְדֵי הַגְּדוֹלֵי צַדִּיקִים שֶׁמִּתְפַּלְּלִים בְּלַחַשׁ כִּי עוֹלִים עַד עַתִּיקָא שֶׁשָּׁם בְּחִינַת לַחַשׁ בְּחִינַת חֲכַם חֲרָשִׁים וּנְבוֹן לַחַשׁ. כִּי שָׁם בְּחִינַת סְיָג לַחָכְמָה שְׁתִיקָה. כִּי אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְדַבֵּר בְּאִתְגַּלְיָא בְּזֶה הַסּוֹד עַד הֵיכָן רַחֲמָיו מַגִּיעִים אֲפִלּוּ לִגְרוּעִים כָּאֵלֶּה וְכוּ'.
segments.en: All the more so now — when each person has added his own sins and corruptions upon the sin of Adam HaRishon — certainly it is impossible to repair everything at once, only bit by bit. And it is well known that the evil inclination and its armies lurk for a person always, and as soon as he begins to arouse himself to Hashem with some cry or plea, it immediately arouses itself to overpower and provoke him further — seeing that this person wants to flee from it. As our Rabbis of blessed memory taught: whoever is greater than his fellow, his evil inclination is greater than him. And since the person is still in great smallness — since he has barely awakened to Hashem, and his repair has barely begun by a hair's breadth — yet even over this the adversary provokes him with great force to corrupt him, Heaven forbid. Therefore it is very difficult to stand against it. And because of this, many are far from teshuvah — for in truth most of Yisrael are aroused each time with stirrings of repentance, for even the sinners of Yisrael are full of remorse. But because of the great provocation and empowerment of the adversary that provokes against them each time, many fall immediately, and some after a while, Heaven have mercy. Therefore the primary remedy is only to cry out to Hashem always.

segments.he: כִּי זֶה הַסּוֹד לא נִתְגַּלָּה אֲפִלּוּ לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ כִּי אִם בְּרֶמֶז גָּדוֹל וְכוּ'. וְזֶהוּ מַה תִּצְעַק אֵלָי וְכוּ'. מַה תִּצְעַק דַּיְקָא בְּעַתִּיקָא תַּלְיָא מִלְּתָא שֶׁשָּׁם אֵין צְעָקָה וְכוּ' כִּי שָׁם סוֹד שְׁתִיקָה וְלַחַשׁ וְכוּ' וְכַנַּ"ל. וְעַל כֵּן אָמַר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הַשֵּׁם יִלָּחֶם לָכֶם וְאַתֶּם תַּחֲרִישׁוּן וְכוּ'. כִּי שָׁם צְרִיכִין לִצְעק בְּלַחַשׁ וְאַחַר כָּךְ בְּקוֹל רָם כִּי בִּתְחִלָּה צְרִיכִין לְהִתְפַּלֵּל בְּלַחַשׁ מִטְּעָמִים הַנַּ"ל. וְאַחַר כָּךְ נִתְתַּקְּנִים עַל יְדֵי הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁמַּעֲלֶה תְּפִלּוֹתֵיהֶם וְכוּ' כַּנַּ"ל. וְאָז מִתְפַּלְּלִין בְּקוֹל רָם. כִּי אָז יְכוֹלִין לְהָרִים קוֹל בִּתְפִלָּה וְכוּ'. כִּי צְרִיכִין לְהַחֲיוֹת וּלְחַזֵּק אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּכָל מִינֵי דְּרָכִים. כִּי בְּוַדַּאי צְרִיכִים לִצְעק הַרְבֵּה לַה' יִתְבָּרַךְ כַּמְבאָר בִּדְבָרֵינוּ הַרְבֵּה בָּזֶה. אַךְ לַכּל עֵת כִּי יֵשׁ עִתִּים שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהָרִים קוֹלוֹ וּצְרִיכִים רַק לְהִתְחַנֵּן בְּלַחַשׁ וְכוּ'. (שָׁם אוֹת נז):
segments.en: This path of thanksgiving and gratitude is a wondrous path through which to draw close to Hashem from wherever one is — for this world is filled with troubles and suffering and grief, as it is written: "all his days are pain and vexation" [Koheles 2:23] and: "man is born to toil, short of days and full of agitation" [Iyov 5:7]. And there is no good in the world except Torah, as our Rabbis taught [Avos 3]: "there is no good except Torah." And from the very weight of the troubles and sufferings and obstacles of this world, it is hard and heavy for a person to draw near to His service and even to pray and beseech and pour out his distress before Hashem — for the multitude of obstacles and sufferings seal his heart until he cannot open his mouth at all, as every person knows from the heaviness that falls upon him at every moment, day after day.

aligned_segments.he: אֲפִלּוּ אִם אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְהָרִים קוֹלוֹ כְּלָל אַל יִתְיָאֵשׁ
aligned_segments.en: This is the aspect of Hoshana Rabbah — when the sealing of the decree is completed, and the rectification begun on Rosh HaShanah is completed. On Rosh HaShanah Hashem had mercy on us and judged us favorably according to our place — for He knows the inclination of each one according to his place, since He is, as it were, the Place of the world. And through this He truly brought us into the scale of merit and planted in us the path of teshuvah — to cry out to Hashem from the depths of the heart, in the aspect of "from the depths I called to You, Hashem," which begins on Rosh HaShanah. And now on Hoshana Rabbah, at the end of Sukkos, all of Yisrael merits this aspect — to fulfill "do not judge your fellow until you have reached his place" [Avos 2:4], but to judge everyone favorably, and to fulfill "do not despise any person, whoever he may be" [Avos 4:3]. For during Sukkos we all merited to sit in the sukkah which is the aspect of the Throne of Glory — the Place of the world. And through this there was illuminated upon each and every person in Yisrael an illumination from the aspect of the Place of the world, to know to judge everyone favorably — even the sinners of Yisrael, the worst of the worst — until we merit to bring everyone into the scale of merit and to illuminate in them the illumination of Rosh HaShanah: that they always find an opening and a path to teshuvah, in every place they are, at every time and moment. And the essential opening and path is to cry out always from the depths of the heart to Hashem, whatever the situation — and never to despair of crying out, as Rabbainu of blessed memory warned about this countless times in many and various formulations.

aligned_segments.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת סוֹד קְרִיעַת יַם סוּף כִּי מְבאָר בִּפְרִי עֵץ חַיִּים שֶׁהוּא סוֹד מחִין דְּקַטְנוּת מְאד וְכוּ' שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהַמְתִּיקָם אֶלָּא עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת עַתִּיקָא שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מַה תִּצְעַק אֵלָי בְּעַתִּיקָא תַּלְיָא מִלְּתָא וְכוּ'.
aligned_segments.en: And this is the aspect of what we multiply on Hoshana Rabbah — crying out many times Hoshana, Hoshana [please save us].

aligned_segments.he: עַיֵּן שָׁם הֵיטֵב בְּכַוָּנוֹת שְׁבִיעִי שֶׁל פֶּסַח שֶׁמַּפְלִיג שָׁם מְאד מְאד בְּעצֶם עַמְקוּת הַסּוֹד הַזֶּה וְכוּ' עַיֵּן שָׁם.
aligned_segments.en: And we stay awake the whole night and complete the entire Book of Tehillim which is filled with cries and outcries and pleas and supplications and entreaties and prayers to Hashem in many and various holy formulations, spoken in the holy spirit, encompassing all who come into the world — until there is no sinner and transgressor in the world who cannot find himself in the Book of Tehillim, which encompasses all who come into the world in all generations and all levels, from the highest to the lowest — to the very end of descent, beyond which there is no further descent, Heaven forbid. To all of them it arouses through its cries and prayers to return to Hashem.

aligned_segments.he: וְעַל פִּי דְּבָרִים הַנַּ"ל (בְּאוֹת מ' מ"א וְכוּ') יְכוֹלִים לְהָבִין מִזֶּה רְמָזִים נִפְלָאִים לְהִתְחַזֵּק בִּתְפִלָּה בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁהוּא אֲפִלּוּ בְּקַטְנוּת דְּקַטְנוּת שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְבָאֵר כְּלָל אֲפִלּוּ אִם נָפַל לִבְחִינַת קַטְנוּת מְאד הַמְרֻמָּז בְּעִנְיַן הַסַּכָּנָה שֶׁהָיָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּשֶׁעָמְדוּ עַל הַיָּם עַל פִּי כַּוָּנוֹת הָאֲרִ"י הַנַּ"ל בְּעִנְיַן הַהוּא נָחָשׁ וְכוּ'.
aligned_segments.en: And on Hoshana Rabbah — which is the aspect of Dovid, at the very end of the days of Sukkos — we draw down this wondrous rectification, that every person in Yisrael will merit, through the holiness of Rosh HaShanah and Yom Kippur and through having fulfilled the commandment of the sukkah and the Four Species — all of which are in the aspect of the Throne of Glory, the Place of the world — through all this we merit to judge everyone favorably and to plant in every person in Yisrael the paths of teshuvah: to recite Tehillim and to cry out to Hashem always, whatever the situation. And this is the aspect of Mishneh Torah [the Book of Devarim] which is read on the night of Hoshana Rabbah — for the entire Book of Devarim consists of Moshe's words of rebuke to Yisrael, a rebuke of kindness, to show them Hashem's kindnesses and His goodness and His righteousness forever. And Moses warned us in his holy teaching that whatever they do in every generation, Hashem's love and compassion for them never cease — as it is written: "And now, Yisrael, what does Hashem your G-d ask of you..." [Devarim 10:12], and Rashi explains: "Even though you did all this, His compassion and His love for you remain after all your sins — He asks of you only to fear Him..." And there is no fear except prayer, as the verse states: "A woman who fears Hashem shall be praised" [Mishlei 31:30]. As Rabbainu of blessed memory taught many times — meaning that Moshe warns and admonishes Yisrael for all generations that after all their sinning before Him, Heaven forbid, the Holy One blessed be He asks of them only fear, which is prayer — to pray and cry out to Him always. And never, whatever may come upon any one of them until the coming of Moshiach — never to despair of mercy, as our Rabbis of blessed memory said: Even if a sharp sword rests on a person's neck, he should not refrain from seeking mercy. And they said: Crying out is good for a person, both before a decree and after a decree. Therefore the whole Book of Devarim revolves around this axis — to remind Yisrael of all that they have angered before Him, yet even so never to despair of mercy. For His compassion is never exhausted, as they saw with their own eyes — that even after they made the Golden Calf, He still did not withhold His compassion from them. And so after all the other sins He dealt with them in His kindness, until they are now ready to enter the Land of Yisrael. Therefore they should know for all generations that whatever passes over them until the coming of Moshiach, and whatever passes over each individual — never despair of mercy, as Rabbainu of blessed memory taught: even if one is in the lowest depths, one can still be close to Him. And therefore Moshe warned them at the opening of the song: "For I will call the name of Hashem; ascribe greatness to our G-d" [Devarim 32:3] — saying to Yisrael: "From me you shall see and thus you shall do" — for know that all I merited in this world came entirely from calling always to Hashem, in the aspect of for I will call the name of Hashem. So too: hurry, do as I do — ascribe greatness to our G-d, that you too call always to Hashem as I do. For this is the very essence of His greatness and honor, as it is written: "Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you and you shall honor Me." Therefore on Hoshana Rabbah we read the Book of Mishneh Torah — for this is the very essence of Hoshana Rabbah: to draw down this path upon each and every person, to cry out always to Hashem.

aligned_segments.he: אַף עַל פִּי כֵן אֵין יֵאוּשׁ בָּעוֹלָם וְיֵשׁ וְיֵשׁ תִּקְוָה עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת עַתִּיקָא וְכוּ'.
aligned_segments.en: This is the aspect of the shofar blasts, which are threefold in every aspect, as the Mishnah states: "The order of blasts — three sets of three." For the shofar blasts are the aspect of the rectification of voices that arouse from the depths — the aspect of "from the straits I called to G-d" [Tehillim 118:5] — meaning that through the shofar blasts, the illumination of teshuvah is drawn upon Yisrael: to always cry out to Hashem from the very depths of their hearts, from wherever they are. This is the primary rectification.

aligned_segments.he: שֶׁמִּשָּׁם סוֹד מִנְחַת הָעמֶר שְׂעוֹרִים שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת עֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה שֶׁלּא נִתְגַּלָּה לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ וְכוּ' וְכַמְבאָר לְעֵיל שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שֶׁצְּרִיכִין לְהִתְחַזֵּק (שֶׁקּוֹרִין דֶּער הַאלְטְין זִיךְ) גַּם שָׁם עַל יְדֵי חֵלֶק מֵאֶלֶף אֲלָפִים וְרִבֵּי רְבָבוֹת שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ בִּבְחִינַת מִנְחָה שֶׁהוּא קָרְבַּן עָנִי שֶׁיְּכוֹלִין לַהֲבִיאוֹ לַחֲצָאִין וְכֵן לְכַמָּה חֲלָקִים כְּמוֹ מִנְחַת הָעמֶר שְׂעוֹרִים שֶׁבָּא קמֶץ מִנְחָה שֶׁל שְׂעוֹרִים מִכָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל.
aligned_segments.en: And therefore we blow many voices many times, three by three. For so it must be — one must multiply cries and pleas to Hashem all the days of one's life and never grow weary.

aligned_segments.he: וְעַל יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה שֶׁהִיא אֲפִלּוּ בִּבְחִינָה זוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: As Rabbainu of blessed memory warned us never to despair of crying out. For the rectification of every matter cannot happen all at once — and certainly one who has caused damage as he has caused damage must tarry greatly in his rectification, in the aspect of: one who comes to purify himself is assisted — but is told to wait. As is written in the kabbalistic writings regarding the rectification of Adam's sin: because of its great magnitude it cannot be rectified in one day, only from Rosh HaShanah until Shemini Atzeres — and even in all that time it is not fully rectified, but only bit by bit each year, until the time of "He will swallow up death forever."

aligned_segments.he: גַּם עַל יְדֵי זֶה יְכוֹלִין לְהִוָּשֵׁעַ. כִּי דַּיְקָא תְּפִלָּה הַזּאת יְקָרָה מְאד אֵצֶל ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ כַּנַּ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: All the more so now — when each person has added his own sins and corruptions upon the sin of Adam HaRishon — certainly it is impossible to repair everything at once, only bit by bit.

aligned_segments.he: כִּי הִיא בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה לֶעָנִי וְכוּ'. בְּחִינַת עֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה שֶׁלּא נִתְגַּלָּה לְאַבְרָהָם, כִּי זֶה הַסּוֹד אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְגַלּוֹת עַד הֵיכָן רַחֲמָיו מַגִּיעִים בְּחִינַת וְאֶל אֱלקֵינוּ כִּי יַרְבֶּה לִסְלחַ וְכוּ' כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַבְנוּ לְעֵיל שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מַה תִּצְעַק אֵלָי וְכוּ' בְּעַתִּיקָא תַּלְיָא וְכוּ'.
aligned_segments.en: And it is well known that the evil inclination and its armies lurk for a person always, and as soon as he begins to arouse himself to Hashem with some cry or plea, it immediately arouses itself to overpower and provoke him further — seeing that this person wants to flee from it.

aligned_segments.he: כִּי זֶה הַסּוֹד הוּא בִּבְחִינַת עַתִּיקָא בְּחִינַת רַעֲוָא דְּרַעֲוִין שֶׁשָּׁם נִסְתַּלֵּק יוֹסֵף משֶׁה דָּוִד וְכוּ' כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַבְנוּ שָׁם (בְּאוֹת מ"ו) וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּהַתּוֹרָה הַנַּ"ל אִתְּתָךְ גּוּצָא גְּחִין וּלְחִישׁ לָהּ שֶׁהִוא בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה הַיְנוּ כְּשֶׁהַמַּלְכוּת בְּקַטְנוּת בִּבְחִינַת אִתְּתָךְ גּוּצָא בְּחִינַת הַמָּאוֹר הַקָּטָן וְכוּ' צָרִיךְ לְהָקִים אוֹתָהּ וְכוּ'. הַיְנוּ עַל פִּי הַנַּ"ל שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ שֶׁתְּפִלָּתוֹ בְּתַכְלִית הַקַּטְנוּת וְהַשִּׁפְלוּת אַף עַל פִּי כֵן כְּשֶׁמִּתְחַזֵּק בִּתְפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים מִשָּׁם.
aligned_segments.en: As our Rabbis of blessed memory taught: whoever is greater than his fellow, his evil inclination is greater than him.

aligned_segments.he: הוּא מְקַיֵּם אֶת בְּחִינַת הַמָּאוֹר הַקָּטָן וְכוּ'. שֶׁיְּקֻיַּם אֶת שְׁנֵי הַמְּאוֹרוֹת הַגְּדוֹלִים וְכוּ' וְעַיֵּן מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב שָׁם.
aligned_segments.en: And since the person is still in great smallness — since he has barely awakened to Hashem, and his repair has barely begun by a hair's breadth — yet even over this the adversary provokes him with great force to corrupt him, Heaven forbid.

aligned_segments.he: וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת וּלְחִישׁ בְּחִינַת הַתְּפִלָּה שֶׁהִיא בְּלַחַשׁ. הַיְנוּ שֶׁלִּפְעָמִים הָאָדָם בְּקַטְנוּת כָּזֶה עַד שֶׁאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְהָרִים קוֹלוֹ כְּלָל.
aligned_segments.en: Therefore it is very difficult to stand against it.

aligned_segments.he: אַף עַל פִּי כֵן אַל יִתְיָאֵשׁ עַצְמוֹ מִן הַתְּפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים. וִיקַיֵּם וְשָׁפַלְתְּ מֵאֶרֶץ תְּדַבֵּרִי וּמֵעָפָר אִמְרָתֵךְ תְּצַפְצֵף.
aligned_segments.en: And because of this, many are far from teshuvah — for in truth most of Yisrael are aroused each time with stirrings of repentance, for even the sinners of Yisrael are full of remorse.

aligned_segments.he: שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מִמַּעֲמַקִּים קְרָאתִיךָ הַשֵּׁם מֵעִמְקֵי עִמְקֵי פְּנִימִיּוּת הַלֵּב וְכוּ' בְּחִינַת צָעַק לִבָּם אֶל הַשֵּׁם שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה בְּלַחַשׁ שֶׁתִּקְּנוּ חֲכָמֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה לְהִתְפַּלֵּל בְּלַחַשׁ בִּשְׁבִיל קְטַנִּים שֶׁבַּקְּטַנִּים גְּרוּעִים שֶׁבַּגְּרוּעִים וּבִשְׁבִיל גְּדוֹלִים שֶׁבַּגְּדוֹלִים. כִּי הַקְּטַנִּים מְאד כָּל תְּפִלָּתָם הִיא בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה בְּלַחַשׁ כַּנַּ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: But because of the great provocation and empowerment of the adversary that provokes against them each time, many fall immediately, and some after a while, Heaven have mercy.

aligned_segments.he: וְכָל תִּקּוּנָם עַל יְדֵי הַגְּדוֹלֵי צַדִּיקִים שֶׁמִּתְפַּלְּלִים בְּלַחַשׁ כִּי עוֹלִים עַד עַתִּיקָא שֶׁשָּׁם בְּחִינַת לַחַשׁ בְּחִינַת חֲכַם חֲרָשִׁים וּנְבוֹן לַחַשׁ. כִּי שָׁם בְּחִינַת סְיָג לַחָכְמָה שְׁתִיקָה. כִּי אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְדַבֵּר בְּאִתְגַּלְיָא בְּזֶה הַסּוֹד עַד הֵיכָן רַחֲמָיו מַגִּיעִים אֲפִלּוּ לִגְרוּעִים כָּאֵלֶּה וְכוּ'.
aligned_segments.en: Therefore the primary remedy is only to cry out to Hashem always.

aligned_segments.he: כִּי זֶה הַסּוֹד לא נִתְגַּלָּה אֲפִלּוּ לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ כִּי אִם בְּרֶמֶז גָּדוֹל וְכוּ'. וְזֶהוּ מַה תִּצְעַק אֵלָי וְכוּ'. מַה תִּצְעַק דַּיְקָא בְּעַתִּיקָא תַּלְיָא מִלְּתָא שֶׁשָּׁם אֵין צְעָקָה וְכוּ' כִּי שָׁם סוֹד שְׁתִיקָה וְלַחַשׁ וְכוּ' וְכַנַּ"ל. וְעַל כֵּן אָמַר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הַשֵּׁם יִלָּחֶם לָכֶם וְאַתֶּם תַּחֲרִישׁוּן וְכוּ'. כִּי שָׁם צְרִיכִין לִצְעק בְּלַחַשׁ וְאַחַר כָּךְ בְּקוֹל רָם כִּי בִּתְחִלָּה צְרִיכִין לְהִתְפַּלֵּל בְּלַחַשׁ מִטְּעָמִים הַנַּ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: This path of thanksgiving and gratitude is a wondrous path through which to draw close to Hashem from wherever one is — for this world is filled with troubles and suffering and grief, as it is written: "all his days are pain and vexation" [Koheles 2:23] and: "man is born to toil, short of days and full of agitation" [Iyov 5:7].

aligned_segments.he: וְאַחַר כָּךְ נִתְתַּקְּנִים עַל יְדֵי הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁמַּעֲלֶה תְּפִלּוֹתֵיהֶם וְכוּ' כַּנַּ"ל. וְאָז מִתְפַּלְּלִין בְּקוֹל רָם. כִּי אָז יְכוֹלִין לְהָרִים קוֹל בִּתְפִלָּה וְכוּ'. כִּי צְרִיכִין לְהַחֲיוֹת וּלְחַזֵּק אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּכָל מִינֵי דְּרָכִים. כִּי בְּוַדַּאי צְרִיכִים לִצְעק הַרְבֵּה לַה' יִתְבָּרַךְ כַּמְבאָר בִּדְבָרֵינוּ הַרְבֵּה בָּזֶה. אַךְ לַכּל עֵת כִּי יֵשׁ עִתִּים שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהָרִים קוֹלוֹ וּצְרִיכִים רַק לְהִתְחַנֵּן בְּלַחַשׁ וְכוּ'. (שָׁם אוֹת נז):
aligned_segments.en: And there is no good in the world except Torah, as our Rabbis taught [Avos 3]: "there is no good except Torah." And from the very weight of the troubles and sufferings and obstacles of this world, it is hard and heavy for a person to draw near to His service and even to pray and beseech and pour out his distress before Hashem — for the multitude of obstacles and sufferings seal his heart until he cannot open his mouth at all, as every person knows from the heaviness that falls upon him at every moment, day after day.
